programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Snap On Tools is hosting their annually convention and needs ATM’s help to wow their attendees. They send one of their giant tool storage chests to Vegas to get the signature Tank treatment. Las Vegas restaurant Nacho Daddy has demanded a custom terrarium.

programs.title: Outback Opal Hunters
programs.desc: The Bushmen bring in a master opal cutter, hoping to transform rough stones into a $100,000 haul.  Sofia and Isaac from the Opal Whisperers are threatened by a mine roof collapse as they struggle to extract opal from crumbling walls.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Drew Pritchard travels to one of his favorite houses in Norfolk and discovers a design classic. Then, he visits a closed museum in a giant windmill and encounters a few hurdles at an antiques shop in Edinburgh.

programs.title: Ufo Witness
programs.desc: Over the past year, numerous UFO sightings have taken place in Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, home to an infamous UFO crash and supposed military coverup. Ben Hansen heads to the tiny town to find out if the current sightings are linked to the 1965 incident.

programs.title: Bush Wreck Rescue
programs.desc: As the build-off competition draws near, Robin snoops around the Wreckless Shop to check out his rival’s progress and makes a shocking discovery.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike and Elvis take on the 'baby Ferrari' but want to keep their costs low. Can the guys make this old school classic car a rival to its Italian cousin?
